sources.label: Avant savUSD unstaking: 24-hour cooldown then avUSD withdrawal
Avalanche PublicNode RPC: pinned reads at block 98704976 (2026-10-27T16:14:55Z)

reserveReview.rationale: savUSD's live ERC-4626 adapter emits one 100% avUSD savings-vault share exposure, and avUSD is the tracked upstream dependency. Avant's current unstaking documentation specifies a 24-hour savUSD-to-avUSD cooldown followed by withdrawal to the wallet. The one-day horizon describes this direct parent-token realization only, not USDC or USD settlement; another unstaking request resets the timer. avUSD's strategy backing and subsequent redemption remain upstream risks and are not duplicated here. Fresh pinned reads at Avalanche C-Chain block 98704976 (hash 0x956348ba335c02a8647ad8963e0c86d02a05b6529be48d2aac08a17d997a0205, finalized, 2026-10-27T16:14:55Z): savUSD vault 0x06d47f3fb376649c3a9dafe069b3d6e35572219e returned asset() 0x24de8771bc5ddb3362db529fc3358f2df3a0e346 (avUSD, no ERC-1967 proxy slot set); totalAssets() and the vault's avUSD balance both equal 97,062,928.838820019150920628 avUSD, so the single avUSD slice stays 100%.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Standing single-asset ERC-4626 structure: verified StakedAvUSDV2 source and asset()/totalAssets() pinned at Avalanche block 98704976 (2026-10-27T16:14:55Z); this dates the direct wrapper exposure, not the parent avUSD strategy composition.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No additional direct savUSD reserve slice is identified; the upstream avUSD reserve composition, vault liquidity, and withdrawal conditions remain upstream questions.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Avant documents multi-provider MPC custody, controlled transaction policies and role-based access, but withholds custody vendor names under NDA. This is upstream avUSD strategy custody, not a second direct savUSD reserve basket. Provider reserve shares, jurisdictions, regulatory status, legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation terms are not publicly established; the existing institutional-regulated custodyModel is therefore not independently corroborated.
